#Created so we can call on extracted steps and linear features and others can 
#run it more easily 

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(amt)
library(survival)
select <- dplyr::select
```

##1. Load extracted steps

```{r load}
combined_path <- here("outputs", "etosha_extract_hr1_lcmixed.rds")

if (file.exists(combined_path)) {
  ele_trk_extract_etosha <- readRDS(combined_path)
} else {
  etosha_dir <- list.files(here("data"), pattern = "^batch_output_etosha_hr1_lcmixed_",
                           full.names = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(etosha_dir) == 1)
  files <- list.files(etosha_dir, pattern = "pipeline_batch_.*\\.rds", full.names = TRUE)
  ele_trk_extract_etosha <- map_dfr(files, readRDS)
  saveRDS(ele_trk_extract_etosha, combined_path)
}

nrow(ele_trk_extract_etosha)  # 7,245,194
```

## 2. Prep: unique strata, crossing indicators, land cover NAs

```{r prep}
lin_cols <- c("kaza_vet_fences_linear", "roads_linear", "hydrorivers_linear")
stopifnot(all(lin_cols %in% names(ele_trk_extract_etosha)))

ele_trk_extract_etosha <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |>
  mutate(
    step_id_ = paste(id, step_id_, sep = "_"),          # avoid stratum collisions across ids
    across(all_of(lin_cols), ~ if_else(is.infinite(.x) | is.na(.x), 0, .x)),  # -Inf/NA = no feature
    fence_cross = as.integer(kaza_vet_fences_linear > 0),
    road_cross  = as.integer(roads_linear > 0),
    river_cross = as.integer(hydrorivers_linear > 0),    # any stream order (1-3)
    across(c(grassland, shrubland, tree_cover), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))
  )

ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |> filter(season == "wet")
ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |> filter(season == "dry")


saveRDS(ele_trk_extract_etosha, here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_etosha_linecross.rds"))
```

## 3. Checks: crossing counts and overlap with distance-to terms

```{r checks}
check_crossings <- function(d) {
  list(
    counts = d |> group_by(case_) |>
      summarise(fence = sum(fence_cross), road = sum(road_cross), river = sum(river_cross)),
    cor = c(fence = cor(d$fence_dist, d$fence_cross, use = "complete.obs"),
            road  = cor(d$road_dist, d$road_cross, use = "complete.obs"),
            river = cor(d$water_rivers_dist, d$river_cross, use = "complete.obs"))
  )
}

check_crossings(ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet)
check_crossings(ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry)
```

## 4. Fit main SSF + step-length robustness check

Main model has no movement terms. The `slcheck` model adds `sl_` + `log_sl_` only to test
whether crossing coefficients are confounded with step length; it is not the reported model.
Note `sl_` is in degrees here (track built in EPSG:4326); fine for this comparison.

Fitting is slow (~3.5M rows per season), so fits are cached.

```{r fit}
fits_path <- here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_crossing_fits.rds")

f_main <- case_ ~ fence_dist + road_dist + water_rivers_dist +
  cropland_dist + grassland + shrubland + urban_dist + tree_cover +
  elevation + slope + aspect + evi + world_pop +
  fence_cross + road_cross + river_cross + strata(step_id_)

f_slcheck <- update(f_main, . ~ . + sl_ + log_sl_)

fit_season <- function(d) {
  d <- d |> mutate(log_sl_ = log(sl_))
  list(main    = fit_clogit(d, f_main, model = FALSE),
       slcheck = fit_clogit(d, f_slcheck, model = FALSE))
}

if (file.exists(fits_path)) {
  etosha_fits <- readRDS(fits_path)
} else {
  etosha_fits <- list(wet = fit_season(ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet),
                      dry = fit_season(ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry))
  saveRDS(etosha_fits, fits_path)
}

summary(etosha_fits$wet$main)
summary(etosha_fits$dry$main)
```

## 5. Robustness table

`shift_over_se` = change in crossing coefficient when step length is added, in units of the
main model's SE. |shift| < 1 SE = robust.

```{r robustness}
cross_terms <- c("fence_cross", "road_cross", "river_cross")

robustness <- map_dfr(names(etosha_fits), function(s) {
  m  <- summary(etosha_fits[[s]]$main)$coefficients[cross_terms, ]
  sc <- summary(etosha_fits[[s]]$slcheck)$coefficients[cross_terms, ]
  tibble(season = s, term = cross_terms,
         coef_main = m[, "coef"], se_main = m[, "se(coef)"],
         rel_sel_main = exp(m[, "coef"]),
         coef_sl = sc[, "coef"],
         shift_over_se = (sc[, "coef"] - m[, "coef"]) / m[, "se(coef)"])
})
robustness
```

## 6. Do crossings improve the model? (AIC/BIC, same rows)

```{r aic}
compare_crossing <- function(data, label) {
  d <- data |>
    drop_na(fence_dist, road_dist, water_rivers_dist, cropland_dist, urban_dist,
            grassland, shrubland, tree_cover, elevation, slope, aspect, evi, world_pop,
            fence_cross, road_cross, river_cross)

  base  <- fit_clogit(d, update(f_main, . ~ . - fence_cross - road_cross - river_cross),
                      model = FALSE)
  cross <- fit_clogit(d, f_main, model = FALSE)

  tibble(season = label, model = c("base", "+ crossings"),
         AIC = c(AIC(base$model), AIC(cross$model)),
         BIC = c(BIC(base$model), BIC(cross$model))) |>
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))
}

aic_path <- here("outputs", "etosha_crossing_aic.rds")
if (file.exists(aic_path)) {
  crossing_aic <- readRDS(aic_path)
} else {
  crossing_aic <- bind_rows(compare_crossing(ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet, "Etosha wet"),
                            compare_crossing(ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry, "Etosha dry"))
  saveRDS(crossing_aic, aic_path)
}
crossing_aic
```
## 7. Three linear-feature scenarios

1. Distance-to only (`base` from section 6)
2. Distance-to + crossings (`main` from section 4)
3. Crossings replace distance-to for fences and roads (and rivers, via `river_cross`)

`water_rivers_dist` is kept in scenario 3 by default: it comes from the land-cover water
class (pans, waterholes), not the HydroRIVERS line layer, so it is mostly a water-access
habitat effect. Set `drop_water <- TRUE` to also drop it.

Only scenario 3 is fit here. Rows are filtered on the same variable set as section 6, so `n`
matches across all three scenarios and AIC is comparable.

```{r scenarios}
drop_water <- FALSE

f_cross_only <- update(f_main, . ~ . - fence_dist - road_dist)
if (drop_water) f_cross_only <- update(f_cross_only, . ~ . - water_rivers_dist)

fit_cross_only <- function(data) {
  d <- data |>
    drop_na(fence_dist, road_dist, water_rivers_dist, cropland_dist, urban_dist,
            grassland, shrubland, tree_cover, elevation, slope, aspect, evi, world_pop,
            fence_cross, road_cross, river_cross)
  fit_clogit(d, f_cross_only, model = FALSE)
}

cross_only_path <- here("outputs", paste0("etosha_ssf_crossonly_fits",
                                          if (drop_water) "_nowater", ".rds"))
if (file.exists(cross_only_path)) {
  cross_only_fits <- readRDS(cross_only_path)
} else {
  cross_only_fits <- list(wet = fit_cross_only(ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet),
                          dry = fit_cross_only(ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry))
  saveRDS(cross_only_fits, cross_only_path)
}

scenario_table <- map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), function(s) {
  label <- paste("Etosha", s)
  prev  <- crossing_aic |> filter(season == label)
  m3    <- cross_only_fits[[s]]$model
  stopifnot(m3$n == etosha_fits[[s]]$main$model$n)   # same rows as scenarios 1-2

  tibble(season = s,
         scenario = c("1. distance-to only", "2. distance-to + crossings",
                      "3. crossings replace distance-to"),
         n   = m3$n,   # identical across scenarios (checked above; base used the same drop_na rows)
         AIC = c(prev$AIC, AIC(m3)),
         BIC = c(prev$BIC, BIC(m3))) |>
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))
})
scenario_table

# crossing coefficients with vs without the distance-to terms
map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), function(s) {
  tibble(season = s, term = cross_terms,
         with_dist    = coef(etosha_fits[[s]]$main$model)[cross_terms],
         without_dist = coef(cross_only_fits[[s]]$model)[cross_terms])
})
```

```{r coef-compare}
base_path <- here("outputs", "etosha_ssf_base_fits.rds")
f_base <- update(f_main, . ~ . - fence_cross - road_cross - river_cross)

if (file.exists(base_path)) {
  base_fits <- readRDS(base_path)
} else {
  fit_base <- function(data) {
    d <- data |>
      drop_na(fence_dist, road_dist, water_rivers_dist, cropland_dist, urban_dist,
              grassland, shrubland, tree_cover, elevation, slope, aspect, evi, world_pop,
              fence_cross, road_cross, river_cross)
    fit_clogit(d, f_base, model = FALSE)
  }
  base_fits <- list(wet = fit_base(ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet),
                    dry = fit_base(ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry))
  saveRDS(base_fits, base_path)
}

coef_compare <- map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), function(s) {
  b  <- coef(base_fits[[s]]$model)
  m  <- coef(etosha_fits[[s]]$main$model)
  mv <- coef(etosha_fits[[s]]$slcheck$model)
  se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(etosha_fits[[s]]$main$model)))
  terms <- names(m)
  tibble(season = s, term = terms,
         base = b[terms], with_cross = m, with_move = mv[terms], se_main = se,
         shift_cross_se = (m - b[terms]) / se,     # effect of adding crossings
         shift_move_se  = (mv[terms] - m) / se)    # effect of adding movement terms
})

coef_compare |> arrange(season, desc(abs(shift_cross_se)))
coef_compare |> arrange(season, desc(abs(shift_move_se)))

#concordance, just for reference only (we determined this is not model-selection criterion for matched designs)
map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), ~ tibble(
  season = .x,
  base       = summary(base_fits[[.x]])$concordance[1],
  with_cross = summary(etosha_fits[[.x]]$main)$concordance[1],
  with_move  = summary(etosha_fits[[.x]]$slcheck)$concordance[1]))
```
